strategy: End to end tests check the inputs, the split result and the zero people edge case.

e2e_tests.code:
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('shows the three inputs', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/')
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Bill amount')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Tip percent')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Number of people')).toBeVisible()
})

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('splits the bill', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByLabel('Bill amount').fill('1000')
  await page.getByLabel('Tip percent').fill('10')
  await page.getByLabel('Number of people').fill('4')
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Per person')).toHaveText('275.00')
})

e2e_tests.description: Zero people does not show NaN
e2e_tests.code:
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('zero people shows no NaN', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByLabel('Bill amount').fill('100')
  await page.getByLabel('Tip percent').fill('10')
  await page.getByLabel('Number of people').fill('0')
  await expect(page.getByText(/NaN|Infinity/)).toHaveCount(0)
})
